output_format.description: The default output format for wit tools. Options typically include 'iso', 'wbfs', or 'wdf'.

compression.description: The compression level used for wdf containers. Range is 0 (no compression) to 9 (maximum compression).

verbose.description: Enable verbose logging output for debugging and troubleshooting.

default_image.description: Path to a default ISO or WBFS image to use when no file is specified in the command arguments.

game_directory.description: The default directory where Wii and GameCube game images are stored.

wbfs_directory.description: The default directory where WBFS container files are stored.
